description: Ten-row student upsert; existing children move to another city, new ones carry a guardian, phone and pickup like student_batch.import. Upsert mix: rows with an even index exist and change fixed cells, rows with an odd index are new, so the file and every 100-row chunk are half new and half existing. Measured by TestStudentImportUpdateAndUpsertBatchQueryBudget after two warmups (ADR 0067 addendum 2026-11-08, Messplan N10/N110). The batch path writes each row without a row savepoint, because a failed row aborts its whole chunk (#5552, ADR 0067 addendum step 3).
